title_en: to … (I want to do) and -ing (I enjoy doing)
title_vi: to … (I want to do) và -ing (I enjoy doing)
theory_html:
A. verbs + to … (I want to do)

A. động từ + to … (I want to do)

want, plan, decide, try, hope, expect, offer, forget, need, promise, refuse, learn + to … (to do / to work / to be etc.)

want, plan, decide, try, hope, expect, offer, forget, need, promise, refuse, learn + to … (to do / to work / to be v.v.)

  • What do you want to do this evening?

    Tối nay bạn muốn làm gì?

  • It’s not very late. We don’t need to go home yet.

    Chưa muộn lắm. Chúng ta chưa cần về nhà.

  • Tina has decided to sell her car.

    Tina đã quyết định bán xe.

  • You forgot to switch off the light when you went out.

    Bạn quên tắt đèn khi ra ngoài.

  • My brother is learning to drive.

    Anh tôi đang học lái xe.

  • I tried to read my book, but I was too tired.

    Tôi cố đọc sách, nhưng tôi mệt quá.

B. verbs + -ing (I enjoy doing)

B. động từ + -ing (I enjoy doing)

enjoy, stop, mind, finish, suggest + -ing (doing / working / being etc.)

enjoy, stop, mind, finish, suggest + -ing (doing / working / being v.v.)

  • I enjoy dancing. (not enjoy to dance)

    Tôi thích nhảy. (không nói enjoy to dance)

  • I don’t mind getting up early.

    Tôi không ngại dậy sớm.

  • Has it stopped raining?

    Trời tạnh mưa chưa?

  • Sonia suggested going to the cinema.

    Sonia gợi ý đi xem phim.

C. verbs + -ing or to …

C. động từ + -ing hoặc to …

like, love, prefer, hate, start, begin, continue + -ing (doing etc.) or to … (to do etc.)

like, love, prefer, hate, start, begin, continue + -ing (doing v.v.) hoặc to … (to do v.v.)

  • Do you like getting up early? or Do you like to get up early?

    Bạn có thích dậy sớm không?

  • I prefer travelling by car. or I prefer to travel by car.

    Tôi thích đi bằng ô tô hơn.

  • Anna loves dancing. or Anna loves to dance.

    Anna rất thích nhảy.

  • I hate being late. or I hate to be late.

    Tôi ghét bị muộn.

  • It started raining. or It started to rain.

    Trời bắt đầu mưa.

D. would like to … etc.

D. would like to … v.v.

would like, would love, would prefer, would hate + to … (to do / to work / to be etc.)

would like, would love, would prefer, would hate + to … (to do / to work / to be v.v.)

  • Amy would like to meet you.

    Amy muốn gặp bạn.

  • I’d love to go to Australia. (I’d = I would)

    Tôi rất muốn đi Úc.

  • ‘Would you like to sit down?’ ‘No, I’d prefer to stand, thank you.’

    ‘Bạn có muốn ngồi không?’ ‘Không, tôi muốn đứng hơn, cảm ơn.’

  • I like this apartment. I wouldn’t like to move.

    Tôi thích căn hộ này. Tôi không muốn chuyển đi.

  • I live in a small village. I’d hate to live in a big city.

    Tôi sống ở một ngôi làng nhỏ. Tôi sẽ rất ghét sống ở thành phố lớn.
